<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Heebo:wght@400;500;700;800&family=Assistant:wght@400;600&family=Gveret+Levin&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>.bracha-landing{--navy:#102B51;--teal:#079B96;--teal-d:#008A80;--mint:#DCF3EE;--pink:#FBE1E8;--yellow:#FFF0D4;--cream:#FFFAF5;--gold:#EFB629;--purple:#3B2A6B;--ink:#102B51;--muted:#3d5170;
  direction:rtl;text-align:right;font-family:'Assistant','Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);background:var(--cream);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:clip;position:relative;
  --padding-top:0px;--padding-bottom:0px;--padding-left:0px;--padding-right:0px;--gap:0px;--row-gap:0px;--column-gap:0px}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:76px}
body.elementor-page{background:#FFFAF5}
.bracha-landing *{box-sizing:border-box}
.bracha-landing .e-con,.bracha-landing .e-con-inner{--padding-top:0px;--padding-bottom:0px;--padding-left:0px;--padding-right:0px;--gap:0px;--row-gap:0px;--column-gap:0px}
.bracha-landing .elementor-widget{margin:0!important}
.bracha-landing .elementor-widget-container{margin:0;padding:0}
.bracha-landing h1,.bracha-landing h2,.bracha-landing h3,.bracha-landing h4,.bracha-landing p{margin:0;padding:0;color:var(--navy);font-family:'Heebo',sans-serif;text-align:inherit}
.bracha-landing p,.bracha-landing .elementor-widget-text-editor{font-family:'Assistant',sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.bracha-landing img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.bracha-landing a{text-decoration:none}
.bracha-landing :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.bracha-landing .br-in{width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:20px}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
.br-header{position:relative;background:rgba(255,250,245,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.br-header-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:8px 20px}
.br-logo{display:block;line-height:0}
.br-logo img{height:62px;width:auto;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.br-burger{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#EEE6DE;display:grid;place-content:center;gap:5px;cursor:pointer}
.br-burger span{display:block;width:20px;height:2.5px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--navy);transition:transform .25s,opacity .2s}
.br-header.open .br-burger span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.br-header.open .br-burger span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.br-header.open .br-burger span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7.5px) rotate(-45deg)}
.br-nav{display:none;flex-direction:column;padding:6px 20px 18px;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.br-header.open .br-nav{display:flex}
.br-nav a{padding:13px 4px;font:600 1.1rem 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);border-bottom:1px dashed #e4d7c8}
.br-nav a:hover{color:var(--teal)}
.br-nav a[hidden]{display:none}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.br-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cfe9f1 0%,#eaf3ef 30%,#fff5e6 62%,#ffeaf0 100%);padding:10px 0 0;min-height:0;isolation:isolate}
.br-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 20%,rgba(190,225,170,.55),transparent 38%),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 12%,rgba(255,255,255,.8),transparent 40%)}
.br-hero-photo{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-4%;left:-4%;right:auto;top:6px;width:64%;z-index:1}
.br-hero-photo img{width:100%;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 78%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(to right,#000 62%,transparent 98%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 78%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(to right,#000 62%,transparent 98%);mask-composite:intersect}
.br-hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:3;width:62%;margin-inline-start:0;margin-inline-end:auto;padding:14px 14px 4px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center}
.bracha-landing .br-h1{font:800 2.45rem/1.05 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);text-align:center}
.bracha-landing .br-sub{font:500 1.35rem/1.15 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--teal);margin-top:6px;text-align:center}
.br-brush{margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.bracha-landing .br-brush-1,.bracha-landing .br-brush-2{font-family:'Gveret Levin','Heebo',cursive;font-weight:400;text-align:center;line-height:1.2;color:var(--navy)}
.bracha-landing .br-brush-1{font-size:1.7rem;white-space:nowrap;padding:2px 22px 0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0,#f7bfd0 8%,#f9cfdb 92%,transparent 100%);border-radius:12px 40px 12px 40px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.bracha-landing .br-brush-2{font-size:1.4rem;white-space:nowrap;padding:2px 24px 0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 0,#8fd8cc 8%,#a7e3d8 92%,transparent 100%);border-radius:40px 12px 40px 12px;transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}
.bracha-landing .br-lead{margin-top:16px;font:500 1.02rem/1.55 'Assistant',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);text-align:center}
.bracha-landing .br-lead p{color:var(--navy)}
.br-hero-copy .br-btn-wrap{margin-top:16px;width:100%}
.bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0aa391,#007f73)!important;color:#fff!important;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 10px;font:700 .92rem 'Heebo',sans-serif;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px rgba(0,128,115,.6),inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 26px -8px rgba(0,128,115,.65)}
.bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button-content-wrapper{display:flex;flex-direction:row-reverse;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button-icon{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1}
.bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button-icon svg{width:1.4em;height:1.4em;fill:#fff}
.bracha-landing .br-ghost .elementor-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)!important;border:2px solid var(--navy);color:var(--navy)!important;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 30px;font:600 1rem 'Heebo',sans-serif;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.bracha-landing .br-ghost .elementor-button:hover{background:#fff!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.br-hero-copy .br-ghost{margin-top:14px}
.br-hero-waves{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:-6px;line-height:0}

/* ---------- value cards ---------- */
.br-values{padding:8px 0 22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffeef0 0,var(--cream) 90px)}
.br-values-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.br-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;text-align:center;border-radius:22px;padding:18px 12px;min-height:118px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px -14px rgba(16,43,81,.5);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.br-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 14px 26px -14px rgba(16,43,81,.5)}
.br-card h3,.bracha-landing .br-card h3{font:700 1.02rem/1.25 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);text-align:center}
.br-c-yellow{background:var(--yellow)}.br-c-mint{background:var(--mint)}.br-c-pink{background:var(--pink)}

/* ---------- achievements ---------- */
.br-ach{padding:6px 0 30px}
.br-ach-box{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #eadff2;border-radius:24px;padding:10px 6px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);box-shadow:0 10px 28px -18px rgba(59,42,107,.45)}
.br-ach-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 6px;border-inline-start:1px solid #e9deea}
.br-ach-item:first-child{border-inline-start:0}
.br-ach-ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:#FFF5E6;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--purple)}
.br-ach-item p,.bracha-landing .br-ach-item p{font:600 .92rem/1.35 'Assistant',sans-serif;color:var(--navy);text-align:center}

/* ---------- about ---------- */
.br-about{padding:6px 0 36px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cream),#fff6ee)}
.br-about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.br-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bracha-landing .br-title h2,.bracha-landing h2.br-h2{font:800 1.9rem/1.15 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.bracha-landing .br-about-sub{font:700 1.15rem 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--teal-d);margin-top:2px}
.br-about-text .elementor-widget-text-editor p{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.75;margin:0 0 .8em;color:var(--muted)}
.br-about-text strong{color:var(--navy)}
.br-about-photo{position:relative;border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px -18px rgba(16,43,81,.55);border:6px solid #fff;background:#fff}
.br-about-photo img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 40%;transform:scale(1.06)}

/* ---------- services ---------- */
.br-services{padding:10px 0 34px}
.br-head-deco{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
.bracha-landing .br-head-deco h2{font:800 1.8rem 'Heebo',sans-serif;text-align:center}
.br-svc-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.br-svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:14px;border-radius:22px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -16px rgba(16,43,81,.5);transition:transform .25s}
.br-svc:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.br-svc .br-ic{width:46px;height:46px}
.br-svc h3,.bracha-landing .br-svc h3{font:700 1.12rem/1.25 'Heebo',sans-serif;color:var(--navy)}
.br-svc p{margin-top:2px;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.5}

/* ---------- testimonials ---------- */
.br-testi{padding:10px 0 34px}
.br-testi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
.br-quote{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:20px 18px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px -16px rgba(16,43,81,.5);border:1px solid #f4e9de;position:relative}
.br-quote::before{content:"”";position:absolute;top:6px;inset-inline-start:16px;font:800 3rem/1 'Heebo';color:var(--teal);opacity:.8}
.br-quote p{padding-top:20px;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- final cta ---------- */
.br-final{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:28px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cream),#ffeef0 60%,#e8f6f2)}
.br-final-in{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 56px}
.bracha-landing .br-final h2{font:800 1.45rem/1.4 'Heebo',sans-serif;text-align:center}
.bracha-landing .br-final .br-fsub{margin-top:12px;font-size:1.05rem;text-align:center}
.br-final .br-btn-wrap{margin-top:20px;width:100%;max-width:420px}
.br-final .br-wa .elementor-button{padding:18px 24px;font-size:1.15rem}
.br-final-deco{position:absolute;bottom:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;width:30%;max-width:150px}
.br-final-deco.l{left:0}.br-final-deco.r{right:0}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
.br-footer{background:#fff;padding:20px;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid #f1e6da}
.br-footer p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0}
.br-footer a{color:var(--teal-d);font-weight:600}
.br-footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* ---------- reveal ---------- */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.br-card,.br-svc,.br-wa .elementor-button{transition:none}}

/* ---------- small phones ---------- */
@media (max-width:380px){.bracha-landing .br-h1{font-size:2.3rem}.br-ach-box{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.br-ach-item:nth-child(3){border-inline-start:0}.bracha-landing .br-brush-1{font-size:1.7rem}}
@media (max-width:520px){.br-ach-box{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:4px}.br-ach-item:nth-child(3){border-inline-start:0}.br-ach-item:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid #e9deea}}

/* ---------- tablet ---------- */
@media (min-width:768px){
  .br-hero{min-height:560px}
  .br-values-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .br-about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px}
  .br-about-photo{order:2}
  .br-testi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .br-svc-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
/* ---------- desktop ---------- */
@media (min-width:1024px){
  .br-logo img{height:74px}
  .br-header-bar{padding:10px 32px}
  .br-burger{display:none}
  .br-nav{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row;gap:30px;padding:0;margin:0}
  .br-nav a{border:0;padding:8px 0;font-size:1.05rem}
  .br-header-bar{position:relative}
  .br-hero{min-height:680px;padding-top:0}
  .br-hero-copy{width:48%;max-width:560px;margin-inline-end:max(32px,calc((100% - 1180px)/2 + 20px));padding:40px 0 0}
  .bracha-landing .br-h1{font-size:4.6rem}
  .bracha-landing .br-sub{font-size:2rem}
  .bracha-landing .br-brush-1{font-size:2.8rem}.bracha-landing .br-brush-2{font-size:2.2rem}
  .bracha-landing .br-lead{font-size:1.3rem}
  .br-hero-copy .br-btn-wrap{max-width:440px}
  .br-card{min-height:150px;padding:24px 16px}.br-card h3,.bracha-landing .br-card h3{font-size:1.15rem}  .br-ach-ic{width:64px;height:64px}.br-ach-ic svg{width:36px;height:36px}.br-ach-item p,.bracha-landing .br-ach-item p{font-size:1.05rem}
  .bracha-landing .br-title h2,.bracha-landing h2.br-h2{font-size:2.6rem}
  .br-about-text .elementor-widget-text-editor p{font-size:1.15rem}
  .br-svc-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .br-svc{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;grid-template-areas:"ic arrow" "tx tx";padding:26px 24px;align-items:start;row-gap:14px;min-height:230px}
  .br-svc .br-ic{grid-area:ic;width:60px;height:60px}.br-svc .br-svc-arrow{grid-area:arrow}.br-svc .br-svc-tx{grid-area:tx}
  .bracha-landing .br-head-deco h2{font-size:2.4rem}
  .bracha-landing .br-final h2{font-size:2.2rem}
}

.bracha-landing{--teal-text:#00756d}
html body .bracha-landing .br-sub .elementor-heading-title,html body .bracha-landing .br-about-sub .elementor-heading-title{color:#00756d!important}
html body .bracha-landing .br-wa .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#00817a,#00665e)!important}
.bracha-landing .br-footer a{color:#00726a;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 6px}
.bracha-landing .br-nav a{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;justify-content:center;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.bracha-landing a,.bracha-landing button,.bracha-landing summary{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:rgba(0,138,128,.18)}
.bracha-landing h1,.bracha-landing h2,.bracha-landing h3{text-wrap:balance}
.bracha-landing .br-main{display:block!important}
@media(max-width:767px){.bracha-landing .br-hero .br-wa .elementor-button{font-size:.88rem!important}}
@media(max-width:767px){
 .bracha-landing .br-hero{padding:0 0 34px!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero-waves-w{display:none!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero .br-hero-photo{left:3.2%!important;right:auto!important;top:21.5%!important;width:44.5%!important;max-width:none!important;height:46.5%!important;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;z-index:2!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero .br-hero-copy{width:53%!important;padding:6px 10px 0 8px!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero .br-wa .elementor-button{font-size:.84rem!important;padding:12px 8px!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero .br-hero-photo .elementor-widget-container{height:100%}
 .bracha-landing .br-hero .br-hero-photo img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 6%;-webkit-mask-image:none!important;mask-image:none!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-values{padding:72px 0 70px!important;background-color:#fff6f0}
 .bracha-landing .br-ach{padding:36px 0 40px!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-ach-box{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-services{padding:80px 0 90px!important}
 .bracha-landing .br-final{background-color:#fff3ee}
}
.bracha-landing .br-ic img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:contain;margin:0 auto}
.bracha-landing .br-ach-ic .br-ic img{width:30px;height:30px}
.bracha-landing .br-svc-img img{width:74px;height:74px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -8px rgba(16,43,81,.5)}
.bracha-landing .br-mark img{width:78px;height:auto;mix-blend-mode:multiply;margin:0 auto}
.bracha-landing .br-svc-arrow .elementor-icon{font-size:20px;line-height:1}
.bracha-landing .br-heart .elementor-icon{font-size:28px;line-height:1}
.bracha-landing .br-svc-img,.bracha-landing .br-ic{width:auto}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-copy{background:none}
.bracha-landing .br-hero{background-color:#cfe9f1}
@media(min-width:1024px){.bracha-landing .br-svc-img img{width:100%;height:150px}.bracha-landing .br-svc-img{width:100%!important}.bracha-landing .br-ic img{width:54px;height:54px}.bracha-landing .br-ach-ic .br-ic img{width:36px;height:36px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bracha-landing .elementor-invisible{visibility:visible!important}.bracha-landing .animated{animation:none!important}}
.bracha-landing .br-hero::before{display:none}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-waves-w{position:absolute!important;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:100%!important;height:clamp(120px,17vw,230px);z-index:1;pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,#000 38%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,#000 38%)}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-waves-w .elementor-widget-container{height:100%}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-waves-w img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill}
.bracha-landing .br-hero{padding-bottom:clamp(70px,9vw,120px)}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-photo{z-index:2!important}
.bracha-landing .br-hero-photo img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 80%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0,#000 12%,#000 70%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 80%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0,#000 12%,#000 70%,transparent 100%);mask-composite:intersect}
.bracha-landing .br-mark{width:78px;height:auto;margin:0 auto 10px;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.bracha-landing .br-svc-img{width:74px;height:74px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -8px rgba(16,43,81,.5)}
.bracha-landing .br-ic{object-fit:contain}
.bracha-landing .br-ach-ic .br-ic{width:30px;height:30px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.bracha-landing .br-svc-img{width:100%;height:150px;border-radius:18px}.bracha-landing .br-svc{grid-template-columns:1fr auto!important}}

.bracha-landing .br-header-w{position:sticky!important;top:0;z-index:60;width:100%}
.bracha-landing .br-header{position:relative;top:auto}
@media(min-width:1024px){.bracha-landing .br-nav{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;height:84px;transform:translateX(-50%);align-items:center;margin:0;padding:0}}
.bracha-landing .br-dash{display:block;width:34px;height:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(100deg,#EFB629 0 3px,transparent 3px 8px)}
.bracha-landing .br-head-deco::before,.bracha-landing .br-head-deco::after{display:none!important;content:none!important}
.bracha-landing .br-final-in{padding-bottom:120px!important}
@media(min-width:768px){.bracha-landing .br-final-in{padding-bottom:70px!important}}
.bracha-landing .br-deco{position:absolute!important;bottom:0;z-index:1;width:30%;max-width:150px;pointer-events:none}
.bracha-landing .br-deco.l{left:0}.bracha-landing .br-deco.r{right:0}
.bracha-landing .br-deco svg{position:static;width:100%;height:auto}
.bracha-landing .br-head-deco{justify-content:center!important;align-items:center!important;width:100%;gap:12px}
.bracha-landing .br-head-deco::before,.bracha-landing .br-head-deco::after{flex:none}
@media(min-width:1024px){.bracha-landing .br-hero-photo img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 78%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0,#000 10%,#000 62%,transparent 98%)}}

אני ברכה ברנס, אשת חינוך ומנטורית לגיל הרך.

בעלת תואר ראשון ושני בחינוך, זוכת תואר “מורת המאה” מטעם משרד החינוך, ומנהלת גן חובה מעל 20 שנה.

לאורך השנים ליוויתי מאות ילדים במעבר מהגן לכיתה א׳, מתוך אמונה שכל ילד וילדה יכולים לצמוח ולממש את היכולות שלהם.

אני מתמחה בהכנה מיטבית לכיתה א׳, תוך פיתוח מסוגלות, ביטחון עצמי ומיומנויות רגשיות, חברתיות ולימודיות.

בנוסף, אני מתמחה בשיטת לימוד ייחודית לרכישת הקריאה, המיועדת לילדים שטרם רכשו את מיומנות הקריאה – בכל גיל.

תהליך אישי המותאם לצרכים, ליכולות ולקצב ההתפתחות של כל ילד וילדה.

<script>(function(){
var h=document.getElementById('br-header');if(!h)return;
var b=h.querySelector('.br-burger');
function set(o){h.classList.toggle('open',o);b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);b.setAttribute('aria-label',o?'סגירת תפריט':'פתיחת תפריט');}
b.addEventListener('click',function(){set(!h.classList.contains('open'));});
h.querySelectorAll('.br-nav a').forEach(function(a){
  var t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
  if(t&&t.offsetParent===null&&a.getAttribute('href')!=='#top'){a.hidden=true;}
  a.addEventListener('click',function(){set(false);});});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&h.classList.contains('open')){set(false);b.focus();}});
document.documentElement.lang='he-IL';
})();</script>
